title: The film Evangeline and the geographic magazine photo
summary: He played banjo in a Paramount film and appeared in a magazine.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Oh, I see. Eddie Morgan, yeah. Well what was this, Paramount made your pictures, is that the back category?
Evangeline, Evangeline, Evangeline, they shot scenes out there, Evangeline out there back of Cattahooly Lakes.
And you were playing your guitar or something?
That was way back then in 35, 36, something like that. That picture was shot about out there. Do you know the name of the picture?

I never saw you. The Lord of the Ryo in there was the feature story. Well I'd love to see that. And we'd play, and I would, I had a geographic magazine, I'm going to try to get some of them things. Yeah, I'd love to see them. The letters and stuff. Do you remember, geographic magazine, do you remember when they had them boys that used to dance on the street, used to play them tin can bands? Yeah, I remember those things.
Huh? Yeah, I remember those things. They're still going, you know, at carnival.

No, but I'm talking about that way back then of geographic magazine. My picture's in the magazine, on the Ouachita River, you understand, I mean on the Boots and the Old Man River and stuff like that. Now I'm not lying to you, that's the fact. I keep a lot of stuff but I don't keep it around. I had some stuff, my son got old to it, showing people, you know how to cheer and all.
